test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

While one cannot really say the pandemic is over yet, it is a sensible decision to now________ to the older system.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Revert'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word to fill in the blank is **"revert".**
 
• **"Revert"** means to return to (a previous state, condition, practice, etc.).
 
• It** fits best** in the context of the sentence, which implies a return to a previous system or way of doing things.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *While one cannot really say the pandemic is over yet, it is a sensible decision to now **revert **to the older system.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, explaining the other options:
 
 
• **Sympathise - **This means to have feelings of pity and sorrow for someone else's misfortune. It doesn't fit in the context of this sentence because it doesn't make sense to "sympathise to the older system".
 
• **Comprehend - **This means to grasp mentally; understand. Again, this does not fit in the context of the sentence as you can't "comprehend to the older system".
 
• **Stick -** This can mean to adhere or remain attached, as to an idea, hope, memory, etc. However, in this context, "stick to the older system" would imply that they have been using the older system all along, which is not what the sentence is saying.
